title: How sharp are your shopping instincts?

questions.title: The bigger bag wins… right?
questions.prompt: Which bag costs less per 100 g?
questions.explanation: Pocket oats cost €0.45 per 100 g. Family oats cost €0.50 per 100 g. Bigger isn’t always cheaper.

questions.title: A sneaky checkout twist
questions.prompt: Same mug, same delivery date. Which order costs less in total?
questions.explanation: Cup Corner totals €11. Mug Market totals €12 once delivery is included.

questions.title: Build your picnic
questions.prompt: You have €10. Which basket leaves at least €1 for the bus?
questions.explanation: Basket A costs €9 and leaves €1. Basket B costs €9.50 and leaves only €0.50.

questions.title: Three pairs. One decision.
questions.prompt: You need exactly 3 identical pairs of socks. Which offer costs less?
questions.explanation: Buy 2, get 1 free costs 2 × €4 = €8 for three pairs. The pack costs €9.

questions.title: Big sticker, small saving?
questions.prompt: These are identical lamps. Which sale price is lower?
questions.explanation: Shop A: €40 − €10 = €30. Shop B: €35 − €7 = €28. Compare the final price, not the sticker.

questions.title: The party needs 12
questions.prompt: You need at least 12 paper cups. Which purchase costs less?
questions.explanation: Two small packs provide all 12 cups for €4. The large pack costs €4.50, even if each cup is cheaper.

questions.title: Read the tiny print
questions.prompt: Your basket is €18 before delivery. Which coupon can you use?
questions.explanation: An €18 items subtotal meets the €15 minimum for SAVE2, but not the €20 minimum for SAVE3.

questions.title: Keep the bottle
questions.prompt: You already own the bottle. Which option costs less per 500 ml of soap?
questions.explanation: The refill contains two lots of 500 ml, so each costs €2.50. The fresh bottle costs €3 per 500 ml.

questions.title: Just one movie night
questions.prompt: You will use the service for exactly 1 month. Which plan has the lower total cost?
questions.explanation: The monthly pass costs €7. The starter deal costs €4 + €5 = €9 for that single month.

questions.title: The jacket might go back
questions.prompt: Both jackets cost €30, with free delivery and a full item-price refund. If you return it, which shop costs you less?
questions.explanation: Shop B refunds the €30 with no return cost. At Shop A, you still pay €4 return postage.
